title: Latest Product Revenue Rollup
description:
Merchandising versioned the product catalog — the same product_id can appear many times with different categories over time. Finance’s category revenue report is wrong because overnight jobs grab an arbitrary catalog row instead of the current one.

Build the daily category rollup Finance trusts: resolve each product to its current catalog attributes, attach those to sales that match the catalog, apply the line’s discount when computing revenue, and publish totals by category. Sales with no catalog match are out of scope for this report.

Publish Parquet with overwrite. Output columns: category, total_revenue, txn_count. Run uses smoke testcases; Submit row-diffs against each case’s expected/.

problemStatement.overview: Publish trusted category revenue from sales + the current product catalog.
symptoms: Category revenue is wrong when the catalog has multiple versions per SKU.
Finance needs category totals with discounted line revenue.
yourTaskSteps: Read sales from INPUT_PATH and the versioned catalog from PRODUCTS_PATH.
Resolve one current catalog row per product_id (latest effective_ts; tie-break product_name ascending).
Match sales to that snapshot (only matched sales); compute discounted line revenue half-up to 2 decimals.
Roll up total_revenue and txn_count by category; write Parquet to OUTPUT_PATH with overwrite.
Submit is graded with a row-level compare against each selected testcase expected/.
problemStatement.yourTask: Implement src/main.py that produces category revenue totals Finance can ship.
hints: Inner join — sales without a catalog row are dropped
ROUND(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct), 2) per line before SUM

gradeChecks: Spark job succeeds on selected Submit testcases
Latest product version used; category totals match expected/
Each Submit testcase expected/ matches candidate rows
